scope: Representative paired research-mvp runs with the same fixture. Counts depend on run duration; this is not an assertion that all other scenarios have identical log totals. Full final scenario tool errors and state are in results.json.
offline_result: Both configs/flow-bootstrap.json and configs/e2e-flow-bootstrap.json emit exactly the same nine findings below and PASS. No offline/live discrepancy. AssertValid and boot admission reject error severity, not warning severity.

composition_findings.classification: existing optional storage topology, newly reported
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: No declared message-port connections. The component also supplies registered storage capabilities; this finding alone is not evidence that artifact or trajectory storage failed. The isolated stream ingestion surface is unused.

composition_findings.classification: existing optional model output, newly reported
composition_findings.owner: SemStreams default port + SemTeams UI scope
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: agent.stream exists in both framework defaults; frozen normalized declarations retain it when config names agent.response only. No component consumes incremental core-NATS chunks. Completed response/activity qualification does not qualify token-by-token UI prose streaming.

composition_findings.classification: existing optional request API, newly reported
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: No declared component invokes discovery.tool.list. Tool execution/advertisement works in journeys; this optional discovery request API is not exercised.

composition_findings.classification: existing configured capability gap, newly reported
composition_findings.owner: SemTeams bootstrap omits graph-index; upstream processor/graph-index owns request handlers
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: Both bootstraps omit graph-index. Its query.go registers graph.index.query.* request handlers; no configured counterpart is represented. Request-pattern orphans remain warning severity even when required:true. Entity/inspector/domain-filter journeys pass via other graph surfaces; index-specific routes remain unwired/unqualified, not claimed healthy. No index-specific HTTP failure was separately reproduced.

composition_findings.classification: existing unused optional stream output, newly reported
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: No declared consumer for storage.objectstore.events. Event-based storage notifications are not delivered to a configured component; no active journey requires that notification path.

composition_findings.classification: existing unused optional stream output, newly reported
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: No declared consumer for storage.objectstore.stored. The ContentStorable message-output path is not integrated; do not claim this boundary is qualified.

composition_findings.classification: existing unused optional stream input, newly reported
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: No component publishes storage.objectstore.write; its Required field is false. Stream-based objectstore ingestion is not qualified. No required-input admission defect.

composition_findings.classification: external observer not represented as component edge
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: No configured component input receives user.response. The message logger and browser are external observers, not admitted component nodes. Research and run-approval proofs contain real typed final user.response messages. This finding does not establish the separate autoresearch lineage defect.

composition_findings.classification: existing optional watch output, newly reported
composition_findings.observed_or_scoped_effect: No declared component watches this index. Request-based trajectory access passed approval/task-story journeys; watch-based downstream indexing remains unqualified.

ctx, requestID := c.withRequestID(w, r)
	startTime := time.Now()

	// Get optional query filters
	userID := r.URL.Query().Get("user_id")
	state := r.URL.Query().Get("state")

	c.logger.DebugContext(ctx, "listing loops",
		slog.String("request_id", requestID),
		slog.String("user_id", userID),
		slog.String("state", state))

	snapshot, err := c.currentLoopSnapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		c.logger.ErrorContext(ctx, "agentic-dispatch: loop listing refused while loop authority is unavailable",
			slog.String("request_id", requestID),
			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
		c.metrics.recordHTTPRequest("/loops", "GET", "503")
		c.writeJSONError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, loopViewUnavailableMessage)
		return
	}
